headline: Some event resources for event teams only.
Some things don’t belong at events.
Make FIRST loud, but with restrictions.
The ROBOT goes alone to off-site machine shops.
Pit must be left in a safe state.
Carts must be safe and easy to use.
Small ROBOT carts are allowed on the FIELD
If in the pits during Ceremonies, shhhhhh.
Pit person limit during Ceremonies is 5.
Don’t throw items from the stands.
Humans, stay off the FIELD until green.
Be careful what you interact with.
Teams may not enable their ROBOTS on the FIELD.
Asking other teams to throw a MATCH – not cool.
Letting someone coerce you into throwing a MATCH – also not cool.
Throwing your own MATCH is bad.
Don’t expect to gain by doing others harm.
You can’t bring/use anything you want.
Let the ROBOT do its thing.
ROBOTS: use SCORING ELEMENTS as directed.
Don’t put ALGAE on their REEF.
Only throw CORAL if in your REEF ZONE.
An Opponent’s CAGES are off-limits in TELEOP.
Don’t collude with your partners to shut down major parts of game play.
COACHES and other teams: hands off the controls.
Humans: use SCORING ELEMENTS as directed.
COACHES, SCORING ELEMENTS are off limits.
The PROCESSOR AREA has a storage limit.
Get inspected before playing a Qualification/Playoff MATCH.
Unless the change is listed below, any change to a ROBOT must get re-inspected.
Leave SCORING ELEMENTS at the FIELD.
MAJOR MECHANISM, from this year only.
Create new designs and software, unless they’re public.
During an event, only work during pit hours.
Power (most) actuators off of approved devices.
Battery limit – everyone has the same power.
Other batteries for cameras or computers only.
Charge batteries at a safe rate.
The ROBOT frame is not a wire.
Must be able to turn ROBOT on and off safely.
Only use specified circuit breakers in PDP/PDP2.0/PDH.
Only use specified fuses in PDP/PDP2.0/PDH.
Protect circuits with appropriate circuit breakers.
Control the ROBOT with a roboRIO.
Communicate with the ROBOT with the specified radio.
Use specific Ethernet port for roboRIO.
Only use allowed ports and bandwidth to communicate with the ROBOT.
Configure devices for your team number.
ROBOTS must have a signal light.
Only specified modifications to control system devices permitted.
Don’t connect motor outputs to roboRIO.
Control PWM controllers from the roboRIO.
Only approved MXP devices can control actuators.
Control CAN motor controllers from the roboRIO.
Control PCM, PH, and Servo Hub from roboRIO.
Only use explicitly permitted pneumatic parts.
No custom pneumatics and meet minimum pressure ratings.
If using pneumatics, these parts are required.
Compressed air from ROBOT compressor only.
Use the specified Driver Station Software.
The OPERATOR CONSOLE must have a visible display.
Connect FMS Ethernet directly to the OPERATOR CONSOLE.
Only STUDENTS may use the mic.
Only the ALLIANCE CAPTAIN may invite an ALLIANCE.
BACKUP TEAMS due 2 minutes before the MATCH start time.
Be there to be a BACKUP TEAM.
LINEUPS due 2 minutes before the MATCH.
